name: cascade_delete
description: In `delete_customer` at `/api/customers/{c_custkey}`, the endpoint explicitly deletes child `orders` rows with `DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?` before deleting the parent `customer` row. The `monthly_trend` read endpoint at `/api/orders/monthly-trend` depends on `orders` data for its aggregations, so deleting a customer permanently removes their orders from the trend report, causing incomplete or missing historical data.
